post.description: Updates the courier tip for a delivery to the requested value. Tips may only be increased.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The UUID of the delivery associated with the tip update.

errors.message: Requested tip amount must be higher than existing tip amount.

post.description: Submits a refund request for a delivery. Invoking this endpoint begins the asynchronous process of accepting or rejecting the refund request.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The UUID of the delivery associated with the refund request.

post.description: Generates a proxy number that temporarily substitutes the courier's true phone number. The proxy number can be used to call or text the courier as if it were their true phone number.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The delivery UUID associated with the proxy phone number request.

errors.message: Failed to get the masked phone number because partnerId: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 does not have access to the deliveryId: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
Failed to get the masked phone number for the deliveryId: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 and sourcePhoneNumber: +15555555555

post.description: Provide the pickup verification info for a delivery. To be used after the delivery has been created and before pickup.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The UUID of the delivery being updated.

post.description: Provide a signal that indicates the delivery is ready for pickup.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The UUID of the delivery being updated.

post.description: Updates the dropoff information for a delivery. Only available before delivery has been picked up.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The UUID of the delivery being updated.

errors.message: Delivery is in an invalid state to update dropoff location.

post.description: Requests the cancellation of a delivery.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The UUID of the delivery being canceled.

post.description: Progresses the test refund to either an accepted or reject state.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The UUID of the test delivery associated with the refund.

post.description: Progresses the test delivery to the given delivery state. Returns the expected progression time to the delivery state

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The UUID of the test delivery.

200.description: Delivery successfully progressed to given delivery state

post.summary: Emulate a delivery status update webhook
post.description: Emulates a delivery status update webhook for the partner. It is meant just for testing purposes.

202.description: Delivery status update webhook successfully triggered

post.summary: Emulate a delivery refund update webhook
post.description: Emulates a delivery refund update webhook for the partner. It is meant just for testing purposes.

202.description: Delivery refund update webhook successfully triggered

post.description: Accepts the delivery quote for the given quote id.

parameters.name: quoteId
parameters.description: The UUID of the quote being accepted.

errors.message: Delivery quote with id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 is expired

post.description: Returns one or more delivery quotes for the given request.

parameters.name: x-gh-daas-test
parameters.description: Denotes if you're placing a request for a test, ensuring that the resulting delivery will only be progressed by test endpoint requests. This can be used either in testing environments or in production. The resulting delivery cannot be progressed in production.

errors.message: Preferred pickup time cannot be in the past.

get.description: Returns all status update events, courier information, and dropoff details for a delivery. Does not include any quote information.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The UUID associated with the delivery statuses being retrieved.

get.description: Returns all active delivery service areas.

tip.description: The total tip amount the courier receives, formatted as cents.

IncreaseTipRequest.description: A request for when a diner decides to increase a courier tip. Can be performed within 24 hours after delivery.

code.description: A code representing the type of error that occurred.

message.description: A detailed description of the error that occurred.

PublicApiError.description: An error returned by the delivery API.

photo_attachment_url.description: The photo attachment url for the refund request.

RefundRequest.description: The request information for a refund.

phone_number.description: A E.164 formatted phone number. Only 11-digits are supported.

ProxyPhoneNumberRequest.description: A request used to create a phone bridge between a caller and courier.

expiration_time.description: The expiration time of the proxy phone number. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

PhoneBridge.description: The phone bridge details used to connect a caller to a courier.

ProxyPhoneNumberResponse.description: A response containing the phone bridge details used to connect to a courier.

capture_method.description: The method used to capture the pickup verification code.

verification_code.description: The verification code provided by the partner.

com.grubhub.pos.generic.delivery.fulfill.description: Pickup verification provided by the partner.

instructions.description: Dropoff instructions to apply to delivery

phone.description: A E.164 formatted dropoff contact phone number.

UpdateDeliveryDropoffLocationRequest.description: A request for when a diner decides to update dropoff location information for a delivery. Only allowed before the courier has left the pickup location.

cancel_code.description: Codes for reasons why a delivery was canceled.

comment.example: Customer does not want to accept their delivery.

CancelDeliveryRequest.description: A request to cancel a delivery.

delivery_fee.description: The amount of the refund requested to be taken from the delivery fee, formatted as cents.

tip.description: The amount of the refund requested to be taken from the tip, formatted as cents.

contents_value.description: The amount of the refund requested to be taken from the contents value, formatted as cents.

return_fee.description: The amount of the refund requested to be taken from the return fee, formatted as cents.

RefundAmount.description: The amount of the refund requested, broken down into various categories.

reason.description: The reason code associated with the refund decision.

description.description: Additional details about the refund decision.
description.example: Driver was 30 minutes late to the dropoff location.

ProgressRefundRequest.description: The request information for progressing a test refund.

delivery_state.description: The subset of delivery states that a partner can progress a delivery to.

speed_mph.description: The speed (in mph) at which the courier should move to the given delivery state. If no value is provided, the default speed of 30 mph will be used.

ProgressDeliveryRequest.description: The request information for progressing a test delivery.

expected_progression_time.description: The expected timestamp at which the delivery will be progressed to the requested state. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

ProgressDeliveryResponse.description: The response information of a delivery progression request.

external_delivery_id.description: The external ID of the delivery to trigger the webhook for

EmulateDeliveryStatusUpdateWebhookReques.description: The request information for emulating a delivery status update webhook.

Assigned.description: An event indicating the delivery has been assigned.

Canceled.description: An event indicating that the delivery was canceled.

source.description: Types of actors who may update a delivery.

reason_code.description: Codes for reasons why a delivery was canceled.

CourierAtDropoff.description: An event indicating the assigned courier has arrived at the delivery's dropoff location.

CourierAtPickup.description: An event indicating the assigned courier has arrived at the delivery's pickup location.

Created.description: An event representing the creation of a delivery.

Delivered.description: An event indicating the delivery has been successfully delivered.

InTransit.description: An event indicating the assigned courier has departed the restaurant with the delivery.

PickedUp.description: An event indicating the delivery has been picked up by the assigned courier.

PickupVerification.description: An event containing pickup verification information.

ProofOfDelivery.description: An event containing proof of delivery information.

ReturnArrived.description: An event indicating the courier has arrived back at the pickup location with the portion of the delivery's contents being returned.

ReturnCompleted.description: An event indicating that the necessary portion of the delivery's contents have been successfully returned to the pickup location.

ReturnInitiated.description: An event indicating the delivery is in-transit back to the pickup location in order to return some portion of the delivery's contents.

return_reason.description: The reason the delivery's contents are being returned.

Unassigned.description: An event indicating the delivery has been unassigned. An unassigned delivery may still be reassigned to another driver later.

external_id.description: A stored correlation id that isn't used by Grubhub's platform.

external_source.description: The external source API from which the delivery came from.

reference_number.description: An external delivery identifier that is used by Grubhub's platform for display purposes.

ClientData.description: Client metadata associated with a delivery.

delivery_id.description: A unique identifier of this delivery.

events.description: A history of notable events that have occurred for this delivery.

Delivery.description: The information and historical events associated with a delivery.

timestamp.description: The time at which this event occurred. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

DeliveryEvent.description: An event during the course of a single delivery's lifecycle.

photo_url.description: A URL to the dropoff photo taken by the driver upon completing the delivery.

photo_capture_time.description: The timestamp at which the dropoff photo was captured. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

photo_expiration_time.description: The timestamp when the dropoff photo will expire. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

picked_up.description: The estimated pickup time, or the actual pickup time if the pickup has already occurred. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

dropped_off.description: The estimated drop-off time, or the actual drop-off time if the pickup has already occurred. Formatted as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

EstimatedEventTimes.description: The latest known estimates for the delivery pickup and dropoff times. Will be the actual times if the event has already occurred.

GeoLocation.description: The last known location of the courier.

result.description: The result of pickup verification process.

capture_method.description: The method used to capture the pickup verification code.

failure_reason.description: The reason for the verification failure, if applicable.

attempts_count.description: The number of verification attempts made.

photo_url.description: A URL to the pickup verification photo, if applicable.

AcceptQuoteResponse.description: The response information for a quote acceptance request.

country_code.description: The ISO-3166 country code of the address.

country_area.description: The country area or state of the address.

street_address.description: The street address details of the address.

postal_code.description: The postal code of the address.

company_name.description: The company name of the address.

DeliveryAddress.description: The information associated with an address.

tip.description: The tip amount the courier receives, formatted as cents.

contents_value.description: The amount the items being delivered are worth minus taxes, formatted as cents.

Charges.description: The charges associated with a delivery.

weight.description:
The weight category of a delivery.

**STANDARD** <= 15 lbs

**HEAVY** > 15 lbs

dimensions.description:
The size category of a delivery based on its dimensions.

**SMALL** - single item, may be carried in one hand

**MEDIUM** - requires a bag, may be carried in one hand

**LARGE** - may require two hands

**EXTRA_LARGE** - may require multiple trips or equipment
